decision.rationale: A standalone implementation that imports none of M401, M397, M394 or M43 and reads none of their CSV files independently rebuilt the full static codec, all 17,280 H67 phases and all cycle variants. It exactly reproduces the 669,012,336-cycle anchor and the 641,790,704-cycle combined result, or 1.1563713549830412x versus the unchanged 742,148,386-cycle baseline. The zero-blocking point clears the frozen 1.15/645,346,422 gate and may advance to selected RTL/VCS/Synopsys. The margin is fragile: only 3,555,718 cycles or 0.0651098 average blocking cycle per replayed descriptor remain, and the frozen 0.25 sensitivity falls to 1.1322843229x.

contribution_decomposition.interpretation: The 70.37 MB extra two-tile PWP capacity traffic is mostly hidden for tile1; tile0 exposes 1,099,508 additional data cycles. Narrow service removes one cycle from each of 24,586,812 runtime block descriptors, while eligibility-clean q16 exact hits remove 3,751,608 matcher tasks.

findings.title: The 1.15 margin tolerates only 0.0651 blocking cycle per replayed descriptor
findings.detail: The zero-blocking point has 3,555,718 cycles of margin. A 0.25-cycle average penalty produces 655,443,488 cycles and 1.1322843x, so selected RTL must directly measure and bound request/FIFO/backend bubbles.

findings.title: One-cycle narrow service saving is not yet an RTL observation
findings.detail: The recurrence removes exactly one cycle for each narrow 96-lane block descriptor. Arithmetic validates the narrow value, but VCS must prove the decoder/datapath actually realizes that service difference without flag or transition bubbles.

findings.title: The fixed 640-byte format increases PWP traffic
findings.detail: Exact capacity charging increases two-tile PWP bytes from 633,316,608 to 703,685,120. Tile1 is hidden in this recurrence and tile0 exposes 1,099,508 extra data cycles, but a physical DMA/memory implementation may have different overlap.

findings.title: The accepted comparison remains simulator-to-simulator
findings.detail: The 742,148,386-cycle baseline and four candidates are independently exact under one recurrence, but there is no matched-frequency baseline/candidate RTL real-trace measurement yet.

findings.title: Physical SRAM, timing and energy remain unproven
findings.detail: No macro, placed interconnect, SPEF, SAIF/PTPX or energy-per-inference result accompanies the new 96-byte config, 640-byte center stride or narrow decoder.

findings.title: Scope remains four Conv modules on a single runtime sequence cohort
findings.detail: The result covers ten zurich_city_09_a samples and four bottleneck Conv3x3 modules. Cross-sequence/density stability, full-network Amdahl impact and system speedup are not admitted.

required: VCS exact codec, flag and q16 early-stop semantics with malformed-sidecar negative tests
measured ready/valid/FIFO blocking below the 0.0651098-cycle average budget or an updated speedup below 1.15
cycle attribution for config, tile0 DMA, replay0, hidden/exposed tile1 DMA, replay1 and tails
DC/Formality/PT at a common baseline/candidate clock before physical throughput promotion
